params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $d=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'heaven-codex-workspacewrite-probe'; if(Test-Path $d){Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $d}; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $d | Out-Null; $prompt='Create a file named proof.txt in the current working directory containing exactly WORKSPACE_WRITE_OK followed by a newline. Do not modify anything else. Then finish.'; $prompt | codex -a never -s workspace-write exec --skip-git-repo-check -C $d -; $ec=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('CODEX_EXIT='+$ec); $p=Join-Path $d 'proof.txt'; if(Test-Path $p){Write-Output ('PROOF='+((Get-Content $p -Raw).Trim()))}else{Write-Output 'PROOF=MISSING'}; if($ec -ne 0){exit 51}; if(-not (Test-Path $p)){exit 52}; if(((Get-Content $p -Raw).Trim()) -ne 'WORKSPACE_WRITE_OK'){exit 53}; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $d; exit 0
